title: Coordenador(a) Educacional | Rio de Janeiro | RJ
description:
Rio de Janeiro/RJ
Código de referência: CE RJ24
Vaga Permanente

Segmento: Educação Infantil e Ensino Fundamental I

DESCRIÇÃO SINTÉTICA DO CARGO:

  • Responsabilizar-se, em parceria com as Coordenações Pedagógicas de Segmento, pelo planejamento e implantação da proposta pedagógica;
  • Realizar a gestão da sua unidade de negócio (segmento) garantindo a sustentabilidade e os resultados, considerando a excelência acadêmica;
  • Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos alunos nos níveis cognitivo, psicosexual, afetivo e social;
  • Promover a parceria Escola/Família.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

1.Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com a equipe pedagógica, com foco nos resultados garantindo a implementação da proposta pedagógica:

1.1 – Implementa, junto com a equipe pedagógica, o planejamento anual em conformidade com o projeto pedagógico do colégio.
1.2 – Participa, junto ao Serviço de Orientação Religiosa, do planejamento dos dias de formação e convivência.

1.3 – Colabora com informações relevantes no processo de avaliação de professores, em parceria com as CPS’s , a partir do acompanhamento realizado aos estudantes.
1.4 – Promove estudos que propiciem a qualificação e atuação dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
1.5 – Responsabiliza-se pelo processo de enturmação de estudantes.

1.6 – Mantém parceria constante com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento quanto ao processo de intervenção e acompanhamento dos estudantes junto aos professores.
1.7 – Elaborar em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento os processos de organização dos Conselhos de Classe.

1.8 – Conduz os Conselhos de Classe, orientando as discussões.

1.9 – Cumpre o Plano de Metas estabelecido a partir da Avaliação de Desempenho.

2 – Realizar gestão de processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento da aprendizagem dos estudantes considerando a excelência acadêmica:

2.1. Prioriza no plano operacional da unidade, as atividades específicas de sua função conforme a proposta pedagógica..
2.2. Estabelece foco na condução profissional das suas atividades.
2.3. Monitora o andamento da realização do plano de ação, visando à revisão de estratégias em tempo hábil.

2.4. Realiza análises quantitativas e qualitativas para respaldar as ações de intervenção junto aos alunos e às famílias.
2.5. Implementa ações que propiciem o processo de autorregulação de aprendizagem.
2.6. Orienta os professores para o acompanhamento do desempenho dos estudantes, especialmente aqueles com necessidades educativas especiais.

2.7.Efetiva projetos de formação de liderança e protagonismo juvenil em parceria com a coordenação do SOR.
2.8. Sistematiza processo de autoavaliação dos estudantes.
2.9 .Realiza projetos, junto aos estudantes, a partir de uma visão integradora dos segmentos.

2.10. Registra os processos sob sua responsabilidade.

2.11. Acompanha o desenvolvimento da aquisição das habilidades cognitivas dos estudantes, incentivando-os na construção dos hábitos de estudos.
2.12. Monitora criteriosamente o trabalho dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
2.13. Zela pelo cumprimento dos códigos de disciplina e ética dentro da escola.

3 – Promover a parceria Escola/Família na condução do processo educacional :

3.1 – Colabora com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento na realização de reuniões com os pais.
3.2 – Inova no atendimento às famílias buscando a fidelização dos estudantes.
3.3 – Estrutura com a equipe pedagógica uma linha de ação para a inclusão dos estudantes com necessidades educativas especiais e suas famílias.

3.4 – Colabora na acolhida e orientação dos estudantes novatos.
3.5 – Encaminha às famílias, por escrito, quaisquer medidas disciplinares adotadas pela unidade em relação ao estudante.

– Conhecimentos na área pedagógica adquiridos em pós graduação lato sensu.
– Conhecimentos na área de neurociências adquiridos em pós graduação lato sensu.

– Conhecimento tecnológico.
– Gestão de projetos.
– Processos relacionados à metacognição e à autorregulação.
– Gestão de conflitos.

Interessadas(os) devem enviar currículo para o email , sendo necessário indicar no assunto da mensagem o código da vaga conforme segue: CE RJ24

  • Tratar com atenção e respeito todos os clientes, internos e externos, fortalecendo a imagem de hospitalidade da Rede Arena.
Descrições mais detalhadas Competências técnicas (hard skils)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão hoteleira (PMS, ERP, Channel Manager).
  • Domínio de informática (pacote Office e navegação em sistemas online).

  • Pessoas: Atender de forma humanizada, valorizando cada interação como única.

  • Ambiente de Trabalho Seguro: Colaborar com colegas e líderes, contribuindo para um clima leve e produtivo.
  • Integridade: Ser transparente, ético e confiável no trato com clientes e informações.
  • Atitude Positiva: Demonstrar proatividade, entusiasmo e disposição para superar desafios.
Formação e experiência desejadas
  • Ensino médio completo (superior em andamento em Hotelaria, Turismo, Administração ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial).
  • Experiência anterior em reservas, central de atendimento ou funções similares em hotelaria.
  • Experiência com o sistema Ópera.
Indicadores de Sucesso
  • Taxa de conversão de reservas.
  • Satisfação do cliente (NPS ou feedbacks de atendimento).
  • Cumprimento de metas individuais e da equipe.
  • Precisão e agilidade no lançamento de reservas.

title: Academic Dean, US Diploma Pathway
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally

Overview

The Dean is a cornerstone of Crimson Global Academy, driving student and staff success through strategic oversight of academic programs and meaningful stakeholder collaboration. Working collaboratively with the Deputy Principal, other deans, principals, and the Head of School, you will support the effective operation and continuous improvement of school programs while ensuring the vision and integrity of the US Diploma Program remains central as it continues to serve students globally. This Dean will support curriculum alignment, maintenance, and development aligned with CGA initiatives, while providing essential support to teachers and students across all learning modes.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Deputy Principal, providing direct support for group class instruction, student services, and day-to-day academic operations. The Dean helps ensure the Deputy Principal can focus on strategic initiatives and complex problem-solving by managing core responsibilities, including homeroom programs, student check-ins, faculty communication, and curriculum documentation.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with forward-thinking innovation – someone who understands the nuances of online education while possessing the vision to help shape CGA as an educational institution of the future. Your ability to communicate effectively across time zones, solve complex problems, maintain a global perspective, collaborate across departments, and execute with precision will be essential to your success.

Key Responsibilities 1. Student Success & Community Building
  • Support the Deputy Principal in ensuring comprehensive student services and engagement across all learning modes
  • Attend and support student processes and school-wide assemblies
  • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities
  • Support and mentor student leaders in their roles and initiatives, coordinating with the Deputy Principal on NHS and club activities
  • Attend and contribute to ceremonies that celebrate student achievements and student recognition programs
  • Support implementation of best practices in online high school community engagement
  • Proactively monitor student attendance and academic performance, implementing intervention strategies when necessary and escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal
  • Conduct regular student check‑ins to identify challenges and provide timely support, serving as a first point of contact before escalation
  • Lead student homeroom programs across all sections to ensure consistent quality
  • Support students across all three learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with student wellbeing programs and family communications
2. Faculty Development & Curriculum Support
  • Collaborate with the Deputy Principal, principals, other deans, and school leadership on policy development, implementation, and review
  • Support group class teachers in delivering high‑quality instruction across all courses, assisting the Deputy Principal with teacher observations and feedback
  • Lead curriculum alignment, maintenance, and creation initiatives to ensure consistency with CGA standards and educational goals, supporting the Deputy Principal's oversight of academic programs
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive curriculum review cycle to continuously enhance educational offerings
  • Create curriculum mapping documentation to ensure vertical and horizontal alignment across grade levels and subjects, supporting the Deputy Principal's curriculum oversight responsibilities
  • Establish and maintain curriculum standards that reflect both US diploma requirements and global best practices
  • Design and implement assessment strategies that align with curriculum objectives and measure student achievement effectively
  • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
  • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching, and maintain consistent staff communication
  • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes, supporting the Deputy Principal's staff development initiatives
  • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy
  • Provide day‑to‑day support for group class instructors, allowing the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic instructional leadership
3. Operational Excellence & Administrative Support
  • Partner with the Deputy Principal and leadership team on policy development, implementation, and periodic review
  • Support the Deputy Principal with calendar management and timetabling coordination, ensuring timely communication of important dates to all stakeholders
  • Assist with schedule changes and resolve minor conflicts, escalating complex issues to the Deputy Principal
  • Coordinate effectively across multiple time zones to support CGA's global student body
  • Support in maintaining organized student records and documentation in the student information system, ensuring data accuracy and clarity
  • Monitor and help approve students through the Enrollment Improvement Channel, working collaboratively with Admissions Officers and the Deputy Principal
  • Apply strong knowledge of the US diploma system and transfer credit policy to support student academic planning and course placement decisions
  • Review and evaluate transfer credits in accordance with school policy, escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal as needed
  • Assist with communications to students, parents, and staff regarding academic programs, policies, and diploma requirements
  • Support AP course coordination and College Board requirements as needed
  • Take on additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by Crimson Global Academy
  • Maintain and update staff and student‑facing documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance
  • Support coordination and consistency across CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses learning modes
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with admissions support activities, including academic planning discussions and information sessions
  • Help manage day‑to‑day operational tasks, enabling the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic problem‑solving and complex challenges
Qualifications
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in education, with demonstrated success in student and curriculum support
  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements, and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in education program development and execution
  • Experience supporting group class instruction and teacher development
  • Understanding of differentiated instruction and learning accommodations
  • Experience with student information systems and maintaining accurate academic records
  • Counseling experience or qualification (preferred)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong task prioritization abilities
  • Adaptable mindset with capacity to pivot quickly in response to changing needs
  • Self‑directed work style with ability to execute independently while maintaining alignment with institutional goals
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across leadership levels, particularly in supporting the Deputy Principal's strategic initiatives
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills to support operational efficiency
  • Passion for educational innovation and willingness to initiate self‑driven projects that advance the school's mission
About Crimson Global Academy

Crimson Global Academy is a premier online high school delivering world‑class education through innovative digital platforms. Our US Diploma Program provides students around the world with a rigorous academic experience that prepares them for success at top universities globally, offered through three distinct learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses.

description:

Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

Objetivo do Cargo

Planejar, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de marketing voltadas para o crescimento e fortalecimento da marca, com o objetivo de aumentar a geração de leads para a equipe de vendas, ampliar as oportunidades de negócios com os clientes existentes e promover o engajamento com todos os stakeholders. Esse profissional terá um papel fundamental na ampliação da presença da marca em regiões estratégicas e na criação de uma conexão mais forte entre o consumidor e a empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Estratégias de Marketing:

  • Elaborar e executar planos de marketing integrados que alinhem as metas de crescimento da empresa com as demandas do mercado.
  • Criar e gerenciar campanhas de marketing com foco em geração de leads, vendas e fortalecimento da marca.

Gestão de Campanhas e Materiais Publicitários:

  • Gerir a criação de campanhas, materiais de PDV e publicações em redes sociais com a agência de propaganda parceira.
  • Garantir que todos os materiais estejam alinhados à identidade e aos valores da marca.

Fortalecimento da Marca:

  • Desenvolver iniciativas para aumentar a visibilidade e relevância da marca entre stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Planejar ações específicas para fortalecer a presença da marca em regiões de alta concorrência.
  • Desenvolver materiais e cuidar de toda a identidade visual dos balcões, garantindo uma boa exposição da marca.

Engajamento com Clientes Atuais:

  • Implementar estratégias que promovam a fidelização e o aumento de vendas entre os clientes existentes.
  • Criar campanhas de incentivo e ações promocionais que incentivem a recompra.

Gestão de Eventos:

  • Planejar e coordenar todos os eventos patrocinados pela empresa, garantindo que estes estejam alinhados aos objetivos de marketing e reforcem a imagem da marca.
  • Gerenciar a execução e a logística dos eventos para maximizar o impacto junto ao público-alvo.

Análise de Desempenho e Relatórios:

  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho das campanhas e ações de marketing, utilizando KPIs e métricas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre o impacto das estratégias de marketing e apresentar recomendações para ajustes.

  1. Adaptabilidade e Resiliência

  • Experiência em gerenciamento de eventos e relacionamento com agências de publicidade;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de campanhas regionais para aumentar a penetração de mercado em áreas concorridas;
  • Habilidades em marketing de relacionamento e fidelização de clientes.

EY Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas.

Pelo 4o ano consecutivo, a EY está na lista do Great Place to Work como uma das melhores empresa para se trabalhar, com destaque para as categorias de diversidade. Assumir a direção de uma escola vai muito além de ocupar um cargo: é uma oportunidade única de impactar vidas e deixar um legado na educação. Juntos, podemos construir um futuro em que a educação seja dinâmica, transformadora e fortalecida em uma cultura de excelência. Vamos transformar histórias: a sua, a nossa e a da educação de todo o Brasil.

O primeiro passo para a excelência começa aqui. Vem com a gente e faça parte desse legado! ✨

  • Gestão da equipe pedagógica e administrativa: Supervisionar e orientar as equipes pedagógicas e administrativas, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo o alinhamento com as metas institucionais;

  • Atendimento aos responsáveis: Manter um canal de comunicação eficaz e acolhedor com os pais e responsáveis, garantindo o esclarecimento de dúvidas, resolução de problemas e a construção de uma relação de confiança com a comunidade escolar;
  • Desenvolvimento de equipe: Promover a formação contínua de professores e funcionários, garantindo alinhamento às metas da escola e atualização pedagógica constante, além de realizar avaliações periódicas do desempenho docente, com feedback e suporte para aprimoramento;
  • Captação e retenção de alunos: Atuar em estratégias de marketing educacional, elaborando planos de captação e fidelização de alunos, e promover uma experiência positiva para as famílias, consolidando a escola como referência de excelência na região;
  • Inovação e excelência: Incentivar a integração de tecnologia e práticas inovadoras no ensino, acompanhando tendências educacionais e implementando melhorias contínuas no currículo e na metodologia da escola.

  • Formação superior completa em Pedagogia, Educação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão escolar, preferencialmente em instituições de grande porte;

  • Cursar ou ter cursado pós-graduação em Gestão Escolar é um diferencial.

Day off no mês do aniversário;

Ambiente Salta de Aprendizagem;

description:
Chief Audit Officer

Inside Higher Ed is seeking a Chief Audit Officer (CAO) who serves as the institution's senior audit executive, leading the internal audit function with authority and independence to provide objective assurance and advisory services across all university operations. The CAO plays a critical role in protecting institutional assets, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the achievement of strategic objectives through systematic evaluation and improvement of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes.

Benefits
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Planning & Audit Execution
  • Develop and annually update a comprehensive, risk-based internal audit plan aligned with the university's strategic priorities, emerging risks, and compliance requirements
  • Present the annual audit plan to the Audit Committee for review and approval, adapting priorities dynamically in response to changing institutional needs
  • Direct and oversee all internal audit engagements, including financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and investigative audits
  • Ensure audit work is performed in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards)
  • Implement and maintain a quality assurance and improvement program, including periodic external assessments
  • Coordinate audit activities with external auditors and regulatory agencies to maximize coverage and minimize redundancy
Reporting & Communication
  • Prepare and present comprehensive audit reports to the President, senior leadership, and Audit Committee, including findings, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations
  • Communicate significant risk exposures, control deficiencies, and governance concerns to the Audit Committee in a timely and transparent manner
  • Provide quarterly status reports on audit plan progress, emerging risks, follow-up on prior recommendations, and resource utilization
  • Meet privately with the Audit Committee without management present to discuss sensitive matters
  • Review audit workpapers, findings, and reports to ensure quality, accuracy, and appropriate support for conclusions
Risk Management & Advisory Services
  • Conduct ongoing enterprise risk assessments in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and prioritize audit areas
  • Monitor the institutional risk environment, including emerging risks related to technology, cybersecurity, research integrity, Title IX, athletics, sponsored programs, and student services
  • Provide advisory services and consultation on new systems, processes, policies, and strategic initiatives from a risk and control perspective
  • Track regulatory and legal developments affecting higher education, including federal and state requirements, accreditation standards, and grant compliance
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs on internal controls, fraud prevention, ethics, and risk management
Investigations & Special Projects
  • Lead or oversee investigations into allegations of fraud, financial irregularities, policy violations, or misconduct with appropriate confidentiality and due process
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, General Counsel, and law enforcement as appropriate during investigations
  • Conduct special projects and ad hoc reviews at the request of the Audit Committee, President, or senior leadership
Independence & Professional Standards
  • Maintain organizational independence and individual objectivity in all audit activities, free from interference in determining scope, performing work, and communicating results
  • Uphold the IIA Code of Ethics and maintain professional skepticism in all engagements
  • Ensure the internal audit function has unrestricted access to records, personnel, and physical properties relevant to audit activities
  • Avoid conflicts of interest and recuse from audits where independence may be compromised
Team Leadership & External Coordination
  • Recruit, supervise, mentor, and evaluate internal audit staff, fostering professional development and maintaining a high‑performing team
  • Promote continuing professional education and certification for audit staff
  • Manage the internal audit budget and allocate resources effectively to achieve audit plan objectives
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors for financial statement audits, federal compliance audits (Single Audit), and NCAA agreed‑upon procedures
  • Manage relationships with external firms engaged for specialized audits or consulting services
QualificationsEducation
  • Required: Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in accounting, business administration (MBA), public administration (MPA), or related discipline
Certifications
  • Required: At least one of the following professional certifications: Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Preferred: Multiple relevant certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise
Experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive internal audit experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role
  • Demonstrated experience in higher education, public sector, nonprofit, or similarly complex organizational environments strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of developing and executing risk‑based audit plans and managing audit engagements from planning through reporting
  • Experience presenting audit findings and recommendations to audit committees or boards of directors
Knowledge & Skills
  • Comprehensive understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and the COSO Internal Control Framework
  • Strong knowledge of governance, enterprise risk management, and compliance frameworks (e.g., COSO ERM, ISO 31000)
  • Familiarity with higher education regulations including Title IV financial aid, OMB Uniform Guidance, research compliance, NCAA rules, and FERPA
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and audit management software
  • Understanding of information technology controls, cybersecurity risks, and IT audit methodologies
  • Knowledge of fraud detection and prevention techniques
Competencies
  • Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire a professional team, influence organizational change, and navigate complex institutional environments
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Relationship Building: Diplomatic and collaborative approach, with ability to build trust and credibility across all organizational levels
  • Integrity: Unwavering commitment to ethical conduct, objectivity, and professional standards
  • Judgment: Sound decision‑making ability and professional skepticism, balanced with pragmatism and business acumen
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to manage changing priorities, emerging risks, and resource constraints in a dynamic environment

description:
Academic Dean, US Diploma Pathway

Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives? Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part‑time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high‑quality, personalised learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

Overview

The Dean is a cornerstone of Crimson Global Academy, driving student and staff success through strategic oversight of academic programmes and meaningful stakeholder collaboration. Working collaboratively with the Deputy Principal, other deans, principals, and the Head of School, you will support the effective operation and continuous improvement of school programmes while ensuring the vision and integrity of the US Diploma Programme remains central as it continues to serve students worldwide. This Dean will support curriculum alignment, maintenance and development aligned with CGA initiatives, while providing essential support to teachers and students across all learning modes.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Deputy Principal, providing direct support for group class instruction, student services and day‑to‑day academic operations. The Dean helps ensure the Deputy Principal can focus on strategic initiatives and complex problem‑solving by managing core responsibilities, including homeroom programmes, student check‑ins, faculty communication and curriculum documentation.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with forward‑thinking innovation – someone who understands the nuances of online education while possessing the vision to help shape CGA as an educational institution of the future. Your ability to communicate effectively across time zones, solve complex problems, maintain a global perspective, collaborate across departments and execute with precision will be essential to your success.

Key Responsibilities
  • Student Success & Community Building
    • Support the Deputy Principal in ensuring comprehensive student services and engagement across all learning modes
    • Attend and support student processes and school‑wide assemblies
    • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities
    • Support and mentor student leaders, coordinating with the Deputy Principal on NHS and club activities
    • Attend and contribute to ceremonies that celebrate student achievements and recognition programmes
    • Support implementation of best practices in online high‑school community engagement
    • Proactively monitor student attendance and academic performance, implementing intervention strategies when necessary and escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal
    • Conduct regular student check‑ins to identify challenges and provide timely support, serving as a first point of contact before escalation
    • Lead student homeroom programmes across all sections to ensure consistent quality
    • Support students across all three learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci and Flex Courses
    • Assist with student wellbeing programmes and family communications
  • Faculty Development & Curriculum Support
    • Collaborate with the Deputy Principal, principals, other deans and school leadership on policy development, implementation and review
    • Support group class teachers in delivering high‑quality instruction across all courses, assisting with teacher observations and feedback
    • Lead curriculum alignment, maintenance and creation initiatives to ensure consistency with CGA standards and educational goals
    • Develop and execute a comprehensive curriculum review cycle to continuously enhance educational offerings
    • Create curriculum‑mapping documentation for vertical and horizontal alignment across grade levels and subjects
    • Establish and maintain curriculum standards reflecting US diploma requirements and global best practices
    • Design and implement assessment strategies aligned with curriculum objectives and measuring student achievement effectively
    • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
    • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching and maintain consistent staff communication
    • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes
    • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy
  • Operational Excellence & Administrative Support
    • Partner with the Deputy Principal and leadership team on policy development, implementation and periodic review
    • Support the Deputy Principal with calendar management and timetabling coordination, ensuring timely communication of important dates
    • Assist with schedule changes and resolve minor conflicts, escalating complex issues to the Deputy Principal
    • Coordinate across multiple time zones to support CGA’s global student body
    • Maintain organised student records and documentation in the student information system, ensuring data accuracy and clarity
    • Monitor and help approve students through the Enrollment Improvement Channel, collaborating with Admissions Officers and the Deputy Principal
    • Apply knowledge of the US diploma system and transfer‑credit policy to support student academic planning and course‑placement decisions
    • Review and evaluate transfer credits in accordance with school policy, escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal as needed
    • Communicate with students, parents and staff regarding academic programmes, policies and diploma requirements
    • Support AP course coordination and College Board requirements as needed
    • Take on additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by Crimson Global Academy
    • Maintain and update staff and student‑facing documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance
    • Support coordination and consistency across CGA Group, Da Vinci and Flex Courses learning modes
    • Assist with admissions support activities, including academic planning discussions and information sessions
Qualifications
  • 3–5 years of professional experience in education, with demonstrated success in student and curriculum support
  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer‑credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in educational programme development and execution
  • Experience supporting group class instruction and teacher development
  • Understanding of differentiated instruction and learning accommodations
  • Experience with student information systems and maintaining accurate academic records
  • Counselling experience or qualification (preferred)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong task prioritisation abilities
  • Adaptable mindset with capacity to pivot quickly in response to changing needs
  • Self‑directed work style with ability to execute independently while maintaining alignment with institutional goals
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across leadership levels
  • Excellent organisational and time‑management skills to support operational efficiency
  • Passion for educational innovation and willingness to initiate self‑driven projects that advance the school’s mission
About Crimson Global Academy

Crimson Global Academy is a premier online high school delivering world‑class education through innovative digital platforms. Our US Diploma Programme provides students around the world with a rigorous academic experience that prepares them for success at top universities globally, offered through three distinct learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci and Flex Courses.

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement and implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign.

In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in‑depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur вялі Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

Join to apply for the Senior Software Engineer – Industrial Solutions role at Siemens Energy .

A Snapshot of Your Day

Imagine collaborating closely with stakeholders to transform their requirements into high-quality software that ensures scalable architectures, intuitive user experiences, and seamless integrations across IT/OT systems. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of industrial software, making a significant impact on efficiency and sustainability.

  • Design, develop, and architect scalable web applications and services specifically for industrial use cases.

  • Exposure to industrial contexts or IT/OT integrations is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English.
About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Growing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. Our focus is on decarbonizing manufacturing and adopting balanced approaches with industry clients, global networks, tech, and coordinated implementation.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment. Our cross-border team is committed to redefining the energy sector by exploring new possibilities to achieve balanced, reliable, and affordable energy solutions. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy:

Our Office

Siemens Energy's location in One Cotroceni Park is not just an office space - it's a hub for a vibrant and growing community! Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the flawless place work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same! Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

description:
Job description

Aqui, na Log-In, somos um time formado por pessoas disruptivas, engajadas e apaixonadas que gerenciam e operam as melhores soluções logísticas integradas, conectando o Brasil e o Mercosul. Nascemos para movimentar mais do que cargas, movimentamos oportunidades e criamos soluções inteligentes e personalizadas.

Hoje somos mais de 1.000 corações que se destacam por unirem valores que inspiram a companhia. Por aqui, os valores são as diretrizes que traduzem aquilo em que acreditamos, que são: simplicidade, atitude de dono, espirito de equipe, cliente no centro, segurança e foco em resultados.

Nossa cultura e o cuidado com a nossa gente nos transporta para posicionamentos ainda mais diversos, equitativos e inclusivos. O resultado de toda nossa dedicação é refletido em pesquisas de clima realizadas com nossos colaboradores. Em 2022, a Log-In conquistou, pelo segundo ano consecutivo, o selo de Great Place to Work® (GPTW). No mesmo ano, entramos no Ranking GPTW de melhores empresas para trabalhar do Espírito Santo e, em 2023, no Ranking de melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio de Janeiro.

Uma conquista que nos orgulha e nos incentiva a continuar fazendo de tudo para ser um lugar cada vez melhor para as pessoas.

Nossa jornada também é marcada pela inovação, responsabilidade e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time. Será um prazer ter você aqui com a gente!

Main responsibilities
  • 1) Executar, no serviço de quarto (integrante do quarto de serviço de máquinas) os trabalhos de lubrificação geral dos motores principais e auxiliares; as manobras de óleo, água e sondagem; manter esgotados os porões; participar nas fainas de tratamento, conservação e pintura, nas embarcações com praça de máquinas desguarnecida (fechada);
  • 2) Comunicar ao Oficial de Máquinas de Serviço de Quarto qualquer anormalidade que ocorra na praça de máquinas, não sendo permitido o seu afastamento para atender a qualquer outro setor, a não ser por necessidade imperiosa, que deverá ser comunicado previamente ao Oficial de Serviço;
  • 3) Dar imediato conhecimento ao Oficial de Máquinas de serviço de qualquer variação na leitura dos instrumentos de medidas de pressão e temperatura, bem como das indicações dos aparelhos de alarme que possam influir no bom funcionamento das máquinas e aparelhos a seu cargo; e
  • 4) Verificar as condições de operação, pelo menos uma vez por quarto ou divisão, dos sistemas fora da praça de máquinas (ar condicionado, frigoríficas, engaxetamento de bucha, máquina do leme etc.) quando o Oficial de Serviço assim determinar.
Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Médio Completo
  • CIR (Caderneta de Inscrição e Registro);
  • STCW A-III/4;
  • EBCP;
  • TBS;
  • Certificados NRs - Caso não possua, iremos fornecer na contratação. ( NR-6 / NR-20 / NR-33 / NR-35 );
  • Certificado Internacional de Febre Amarela;
  • Passaporte válido;
Additional information

Job description

Conhecendo um pouco mais sobre o grupo Limppano S/A.

Somos um time que Cuidamos da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade.   • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.
  • Montagem de Pontos Extras: instalar materiais promocionais (MPDV) e montar exposições sazonais, campanhas e ações promocionais.

  • Controle de Estoque: Acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.

Requirements and skills

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.

Condições de Trabalho:

  • Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.
  • Trabalho físico leve a moderado (carga, movimentação e organização de produtos).
  • Eventual necessidade de deslocamento entre cidades da região.
Additional information

Além de um ambiente desenvolvedor, oferecemos ao nosso time:

title: Head of Market Analysis
description:
Descrição da empresa

Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma empresa norueguesa, com ações pautadas pela ética e transparência. É líder em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e a maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa. O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis - SC e também escritórios comerciais em São Paulo - SP (Vila Olímpia) e Rio de Janeiro - RJ (Leblon). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

Além disso, a empresa atua na comercialização de energia, a partir dos escritórios comerciais no Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP), com uma carteira de clientes comerciais e industriais de diversos segmentos.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Descrição do emprego

Como Head of Market Analysis, você será responsável por conduzir análises e previsões de preços de energia, bem como pesquisas de mercado, com o objetivo de orientar decisões estratégicas de comercialização de energia e representar a área e reportar análises para clientes internos e externos.

Trabalhando como Head of Market Analysis você irá:

Apoiar ativamente a rentabilidade da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento de análises e previsões de preços de energia, acompanhando variáveis como precipitação, vazão, demanda, intercâmbio de energia entre subsistemas, entre outros, com o objetivo de orientar decisões de compra e venda de energia.

Garantir que as informações inseridas nos modelos de análise de preços estejam corretas, por meio de análise técnica dos pressupostos utilizados nos modelos do CEPEL, consultando relatórios e dados publicados, e realizando processamento de dados quando necessário.

Analisar criticamente os resultados, identificando possíveis desvios e lacunas nos modelos.

Fornecer informações relevantes com qualidade e agilidade sobre fatores que possam afetar variações no preço de mercado, monitorando negociações, notas técnicas e processos da ANEEL e ONS sobre temas regulatórios, através de pesquisas e acesso aos sites institucionais.

Apoiar a melhoria dos resultados de ativos no Brasil por meio do desenvolvimento de análises e previsões de preços de energia, acompanhando variáveis como chuvas, afluências, demanda e intercâmbio de energia entre subsistemas.

Reportar rapidamente e com transparência mudanças regulatórias e informações de preço ao front office e middle office que possam impactar decisões de mercado e avaliações de risco.

Estruturar análises e cenários de preços de forma oportuna, de acordo com a dinâmica dos negócios da Statkraft, garantindo que os recursos e pessoas necessários estejam disponíveis.

Monitorar continuamente informações de mercado e práticas comerciais vigentes para priorizar e direcionar esforços de forma a apoiar soluções comerciais para a empresa.

Qualificações
  • Graduação em Engenharia, Meteorologia, Hidrologia ou Economia;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças/Projetos/Energia;
  • Sólida experiência na função;
  • Conhecimento nas seguintes áreas:
    • Formação e previsão de preços (PLD);
    • Análise meteorológica e hidrológica para o Brasil;
    • Operação e expansão do sistema elétrico brasileiro;
    • Regulação do setor elétrico brasileiro e Mercado de Energia no Brasil;
    • Análise probabilística e estatística;
    • Programação e automação (Python, VBA, Power BI e Shell Script);
    • Inglês avançado.
Informações Adicionais

Conosco, você desenvolverá uma trajetória profissional com oportunidades incríveis. Isso inclui:

  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional em vários níveis da organização, incluindo LinkedIn Learning, programas e ações de desenvolvimento;
  • A chance de fazer parte de uma organização verdadeiramente global, composta por profissionais competentes, inovadores e responsáveis, de diferentes países e culturas;
  • Uma cultura organizacional que cuida e respeita as pessoas, oferecendo soluções de trabalho flexíveis, princípios de equilíbrio entre vida profissional.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e seus dependentes.
  • Previdência privada, com contrapartida por parte da empresa.
  • Vale alimentação/refeição.
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos até 7 anos.
  • Auxílio para pais e mães com filhos com deficiência.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, respectivamente 6 meses e 20 dias.
  • PAS – Programa de Apoio Statkraft, serviço profissional com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, advogados e consultores financeiros.

O que é fazer parte da Statkraft?

É contribuir para um planeta mais verde e sustentável. Ser Statkraft é renovar a energia que impulsiona o mundo: uma energia limpa, inspiradora, com ética, integridade e segurança.

Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar pessoas a escrever a nossa história, com acolhimento e respeito à diversidade em toda a sua plenitude.

Ser parte da Statkraft é vivenciar os nossos valores, é ser competente, responsável e inovador. É ter uma comunicação aberta e transparente.

Compromisso com a diversidade

A visão da Statkraft é renovar a forma como o mundo é movido. Para navegar essa jornada complexa, precisamos de todas as vozes à mesa. Por isso, trabalhamos ativamente para ser um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo, e damos boas-vindas a todos os candidatos, independentemente de origem, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa, etnia, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Nosso processo seletivo é contínuo , o que significa que não há data limite para envio de candidaturas. Enquanto a vaga estiver publicada, seguimos avaliando novos perfis.

Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo através de nossa plataforma. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

title: Director, Finance
description:
Overview

This is a unique opportunity to shape a new Shared Services Center, influence global finance operations, and prepare for a major ERP transformation in 2027. You will work in a dynamic, collaborative environment with exposure to senior leadership and global stakeholders.

What You Will Do
  • Lead and develop a high-performing finance shared services team in Rio de Janeiro.
  • Provide direct supervision to local staff, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the primary point of escalation for operational issues within the center.

  • Ensure adherence to global policies, internal controls, and compliance requirements.
  • Drive process efficiency and standardization in alignment with global frameworks.
  • Maintain strong communication channels with regional business units and corporate headquarters.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across all global regions to ensure consistent service delivery and alignment with global standards.
  • Manage dotted-line reporting relationships to ensure alignment with global process governance.
  • Monitor KPIs and SLAs to ensure service delivery meets or exceeds expectations.
  • Collaborate, recommend, and assist with the implementation of new tools, technologies, and processes to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Implement best practices and support global initiatives for finance transformation.
What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in finance operations, with at least 10 years in a leadership role within a shared services or global business services environment.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams in a matrix environment.
  • Experience managing global teams and operations within multi-divisional, multinational corporate environments.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
  • Proven ability to design and implement shared services strategies that drive operational excellence, cost efficiency, and alignment with strategic business priorities.
  • Deep understanding of finance processes and internal controls.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English required.
  • Experience with ERP systems, Oracle preferred, and process automation tools.
  • Ability to travel occasionally to U.S. Headquarters.
Reporting Relationships
  • Direct Reports include all members of the Shared Services team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
  • Reports to Global Shared Services Leadership.
  • Dotted Line to Global Process Owners (U.S. Headquarters).
About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Utilities processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD) under Global Manufacturing (GM) Excellence Organization.

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities.

Key Responsibilities

As successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
  • Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates) and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including process design, troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, and capacity test runs.
  • Provide detailed service reports for each support activity, highlighting facility needs, actions taken, results, and lessons learned.
  • Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization or process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment, through operational adjustment or design modification.
  • Conduct internal assessments on Utilities using Saudi Aramco engineering standard references and highlight any deviations or better standards applied by affiliates for endorsement to facility management or Saudi Aramco Central Engineering.
  • Act as the overall coordinator for cascading and driving Global Manufacturing and Corporate programs for Utilities in operating facilities, enabling their execution and effective monitoring.
  • Participate in Business Plan development, coordinate with stakeholders for capital investments on assigned Utilities and support techno-economic evaluations.
  • Evaluate and recommend new Utilities technologies, coordinate with Central Engineering to facilitate field deployment.
  • You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of total Utilities unit experience (process engineering and operations) with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling refinery’s utilities.
  • You will have experience in water desalination and boilers for steam generation
  • You will be able to optimize various utility systems, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
  • You will have in-depth knowledge of major equipment suppliers and package units for Utilities.
  • You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for utility systems.
  • You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Utilities performance metrics.
  • You will also have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management.
Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Psicopedagogo(a) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Overview

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes, que utiliza as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e ancorada na cultura vibrante em que se encontra. Trabalhará junto de uma equipe de mais de 13.000 colaboradores em instalações de última geração, ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor, com foco em desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira e mobilidade dentro do grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo, e em pensar nas melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

Responsabilidades
  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Requisitos
  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.
Declaração de Salvaguarda

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperamos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Senior Structural Engineer (Engenheiro Estrutural Senior)
description:
Do you enjoy being a part of successful team Would you like to work on industry leading projects? Join our team!

Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create oilfield equipment is the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best

The Senior Structural Engineering is part of the solution scope for the flexible pipe business and deals with the development of ancillary equipment necessary for logistics, installation, and operation of the system. The activities consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user’s needs. The discipline executes a robust process of design, finite element analysis, optimization of ancillaries, and creation of alternate design concepts, aiming efficiency, smart design, productivity and cost saving.

As a Senior Structural Engineer, you will be responsible for:
  • Lead Finite Element Analysis (FEA) for flexible pipeline equipment and components.
  • Participate in applied R&D projects and equipment design improvements.
  • To develop, check and approve the design and layout of all components and systems like end fitting/ancillaries that compose the flexible pipe systems.
  • Perform assigned technical tasks, including structural analysis, calculations, design, verification, and study activities.
  • Collaborate with other Project Specialists and Designers on problem solving.
  • Coordinate and review technical activities performed internally and externally to ensure compliance with technical requirements and adherence to established deadlines.
  • Create and propose process improvements, as well as provide technical assistance and guide the team.
  • Requiring understanding of a concepts, methods, and procedures.
  • Expecting to resolve problems through the application of acquired expertise guided by precedent.
  • Working together with people from the business unit. Contacts are under guidance and/or geared towards specifying activities, planning of activities, and giving explanations on technical issues.
  • Communicating with team and supervisor. Presenting to internal teams on metrics, project status and research.
Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Civil Engineering or Naval Engineering.
  • Hold active CREA.
  • 10 years’ experience with finite element analysis.
  • Advanced English level.
  • Have good experience in Engineering/ Technology.
  • Experience with AutoCAD, Solidworks, MathCAD and Excel (nice to have).
  • Have effective problem identification and solution skills.
  • Have proven analytical and organizational ability.
  • Strength on ANSYS (Preferable).
Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working from MON-FRI, 7am to 4pm (Flexibility to do 1 day per week “home office”)
Location:

Retic - Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities.

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we’re committed to achieving net‑zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we’re always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.

Join Us

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management

Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services

Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment

Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)

Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary

Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners

Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;

Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil

Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.

Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team

Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements
  • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines
  • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities
  • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties
  • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required
  • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management
  • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
  • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
  • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
YOUR PROFILE
  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.
